lessons.lesson: To add a new language to mrmd-js: 1) Create executor in execute/<lang>.js extending BaseExecutor 2) Export from execute/index.js 3) Register in createDefaultExecutorRegistry() 4) Export from main index.js
For new rich output languages (visual rendering), add to isRichOutput array at execution.js:731 and ensure outputType maps to html or css for iframe rendering
lessons.evidence: Added mermaid to isRichOutput and mapped to html outputType

lessons.lesson: For new language syntax highlighting: 1) Add codemirror-lang-* package to package.json 2) Import in index.js 3) Create support instance (e.g., mermaidSupport = mermaid()) 4) Add case to codeBlockLanguage() switch
lessons.evidence: Added codemirror-lang-mermaid following R and Julia patterns

lessons.lesson: The supportedLanguages object in createBrowserJsRuntime() (around line 357) must include new languages for them to be executable via the JS runtime
